title: Engineering classical waves with quantized energy spectra in periodic media
summary: Field quantization is a central feature of modern physics, that underpins the concept of photons and forms the foundation of quantum electrodynamics as well as much of solid-state theory. Classical linear wave equations are not generally expected to reproduce the quantization arising in quantum systems without introducing additional ingredients such as ad hoc nonlinear constraints, resonant particle-wave couplings or stochastic background fields.
